name: qsmxt
label: QSMxT for Automated Quantitative Susceptibility Mapping
description: QSMxT is an end-to-end pipeline for Quantitative Susceptibility Mapping (QSM). It converts magnitude and phase DICOMs to BIDS and reconstructs a susceptibility map for every gradient-echo acquisition it finds, with a configurable algorithm at each stage: masking, phase unwrapping and field mapping, background field removal, and dipole inversion.
author: Ashley Stewart
cite: Stewart, SW, Robinson, SD, O'Brien, K, et al. QSMxT: Robust masking and artifact reduction for quantitative susceptibility mapping. Magn Reson Med. 2022; 87: 1289-1300. doi:10.1002/mrm.29048

mask_preset.description: MASKING. Masking recipe; 'auto' leaves it to QSMxT's default, which is 'robust-threshold'. 'robust-threshold' Otsu-thresholds the phase-quality map and refines it with dilation, hole-filling and erosion. 'bet' runs brain extraction on the magnitude. 'bet-and-phase' intersects BET with an Otsu-thresholded phase-quality map, then fills holes and erodes (the ISMRM EMTP consensus masking). Deep-learning masking (HD-BET) is not offered here; see qsmxt_cmd_args.

masking_input.description: MASKING. Image the mask is derived from, overriding what the masking recipe would use. For example 'magnitude' with the 'robust-threshold' recipe thresholds the combined magnitude instead of the phase-quality map.

inhomogeneity_correction.description: MASKING. Correct receive-coil inhomogeneity in the magnitude before masking.

unwrapping_algorithm.description: FIELD MAPPING. Phase unwrapping method; 'auto' leaves it to QSMxT's default, which is ROMEO. Ignored by reconstructions that start from wrapped phase.

b0_estimation.description: FIELD MAPPING. How multi-echo phase is combined into a B0 field map: a weighted average of the per-echo fields, or a linear fit of phase against echo time.

phase_offset_removal.description: FIELD MAPPING. Remove receiver phase offsets on multi-echo data.

bipolar_correction.description: FIELD MAPPING. Correct for a bipolar (alternating-polarity) readout. Requires at least 3 echoes.

bf_algorithm.description: BACKGROUND FIELD REMOVAL. Method used to strip the background field; 'auto' leaves it to QSMxT's default, which is V-SHARP. Ignored when the dipole inversion does its own background removal (TGV, QSMART, and MEDI with medi_smv enabled) - the gear drops it and logs a warning rather than letting it silently do nothing.

qsm_algorithm.description: DIPOLE INVERSION. Reconstruction method; 'auto' leaves it to QSMxT's default, which is RTS. 'rts' is a robust, fast starting point; 'tkd' and 'tsvd' are direct and fastest; 'tgv' and 'qsmart' include their own background field removal, so bf_algorithm does not apply to them. Deep-learning inversions are not offered here; see qsmxt_cmd_args.

medi_smv.description: DIPOLE INVERSION. MEDI only: use MEDI's own SMV deconvolution. This makes MEDI a single-step reconstruction from the total field, so the background field removal step is skipped.

qsm_reference.description: DIPOLE INVERSION. Reference susceptibility values to the mean inside the mask, or leave them unreferenced. Referencing to the mean is not meaningful outside the brain.

do_chisep.description: SOURCE SEPARATION. Split susceptibility into paramagnetic and diamagnetic components.

chisep_algorithm.description: SOURCE SEPARATION. Separation method. Only the two methods that run on a gradient-echo acquisition alone are offered: 'r2star-qsm' models magnitude decay, 'decompose' fits the multi-echo signal directly. The R2'-based methods need a matching multi-echo spin-echo acquisition, which this gear does not take as input.

no_qsm.description: OUTPUTS. Skip QSM reconstruction and produce only the supplementary outputs selected below.

do_swi.description: OUTPUTS. Also compute susceptibility-weighted images and a minimum-intensity projection.

do_t2starmap.description: OUTPUTS. Also compute a T2* map from the multi-echo magnitude.

do_r2starmap.description: OUTPUTS. Also compute an R2* map from the multi-echo magnitude.

export_dicom.description: OUTPUTS. Also export the final maps as DICOM series, inheriting patient and study identity from the input DICOMs.

save_bids.description: OUTPUTS. Include the converted BIDS dataset (bids.zip) in the gear outputs.

clean_intermediates.description: OUTPUTS. Delete intermediate images once the pipeline finishes. Saves space, but leaves nothing in workflow.zip to inspect if a result looks wrong.

include_pattern.description: RUN SELECTION. Process only acquisitions whose BIDS key matches these glob patterns, separated by spaces (e.g. "*acq-QSM*"). The key looks like sub-01_ses-pre_acq-PROTOCOL_run-1_MEGRE, so the scanner protocol name appears as the acq- entity. Leave empty to process every gradient-echo acquisition found. This replaces the qsm_protocol_pattern option of earlier versions.

exclude_pattern.description: RUN SELECTION. Skip acquisitions whose BIDS key matches these glob patterns, separated by spaces (e.g. "*acq-SWI*").

num_echoes.description: RUN SELECTION. Use only the first N echoes. 0 uses all of them.

obliquity_threshold.description: ACQUISITION GEOMETRY. Resample oblique acquisitions to axial when their obliquity exceeds this many degrees, as QSMxT 8.x did. -1 (the default) disables it: the dipole kernel is rotated to the acquired B0 direction instead, which is exact and interpolates nothing.

qsmxt_cmd_args.description: Additional command-line arguments passed to 'qsmxt run', applied after everything above and overriding it. Use this for per-algorithm parameters (e.g. --vsharp-max-radius 20) or for the deep-learning methods, which are not in the dropdowns because their model weights are downloaded from Hugging Face at runtime and so need outbound network access.
